messages:
claire (People Ops): quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A on org changes and hiring. dropping short answers here — ask one-line q's pls.
kevin (CEO): summary: prioritize infra, runtime, and enterprise reliability for next 2 quarters. we're moving headcount from non-core to platform.
tara (Head of Eng): consolidation: ~15 teams -> 11 squads. objective is clearer ownership and fewer cross-team handoffs. not a headcount reduction.
liam (SWE): will this change sprint commitments?
tara (Head of Eng): minimal impact. owners will keep current sprint commitments; handoffs phased over 2 cycles.
owen (VP Infra): SRE and infra hires are top-priority. flag reqs as "infra-priority" and approvals will be expedited.
maria (Recruiter): process note: expedited reqs -> post in ~3 business days; standard reqs -> up to 10 business days. include 2 impact metrics on the req.
liam (SWE): contractors ok during transition?
tara (Head of Eng): short-term contractors allowed for experiments (<=12 weeks). long-term ownership should be FT.
claire (People Ops): publishing mapping and headcount sheet tomorrow. preview snippet:
```
Q1 tactical: +10 (infra 5, runtime 3, reliability 2)
Q2 strategic: +14 (platform 6, enterprise 5, research 3)
Backfills & mobility: ~7
```
liam (SWE): manager hires? are we freezing manager headcount?
kevin (CEO): manager hires limited. prefer senior ICs unless manager role unlocks >2x team throughput or is needed for compliance.
claire (People Ops): internal mobility window: 10 business days after mapping pub. leaders must post stretch roles in #internal-moves.
liam (SWE): how will people know if their role is "retained" or being reviewed?
tara (Head of Eng): the published mapping will include flags: "retained", "under-review", "open" and a short note. managers get 2-week heads-up before reassignments.
maria (Recruiter): tip: attach a one-paragraph hiring brief to speed approvals.
claire (People Ops): we'll convert this thread into an FAQ and pin it to the all-hands notes. DM me or @maria for private follow-ups. :wave:
